description: Election Commission - A. G. T. Jayathillaka was Selected as the member of the Imaduwa Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local authority (Imaduwa Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of the incumbent. The content details the process under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, including the nomination by a political party and the official declaration of the newly elected member. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of election results for public offices.
